title: Hiking the Zion Narrows: the trail is the river #Shorts
description:
We hiked the Zion Narrows top to bottom in November 2021. Walls a thousand feet high, in places only 20 to 30 feet apart. When the water rises in here, there's often nowhere to climb.

▶ Full documentary (Zion, Part 1: Zion's Deadliest Day): https://youtu.be/Hlr80lyDlwA

#Shorts #ZionNarrows #Hiking #NationalParks
